ads.headline: Lead gen intent crashed; pivot to brand awareness at $25/day budgets
actions: Switch 60% of budget to awareness campaigns targeting service area zip codes this week
Create 3 short before/after videos (plumbing fixes, clean gutters, landscaping) for broader reach
Test lead magnet replacement: free inspection booking instead of form fills to capture demand
ads.source: Google Trends lead generation interest drop to 15; r/FacebookAds consensus on high CPL in Q1

creative.headline: Unable to provide strategic recommendations — insufficient engagement data this week
actions: HOLD: Don't post until you have 3-5 days of performance data. Zero engagement signals means the algorithm hasn't surfaced your content yet this week.

VIDEO IDEA: Film a 60-second 'What I'm Seeing in Meta Ads THIS WEEK' talking head where you share what's actually working for your plumber/landscaper clients RIGHT NOW. Start with: 'These 3 local service ads are printing money on Meta right now — here's why.' This works because it's timely, specific, and gives value before asking for DMs.

AVOID: Don't rely on Google Trends data showing zeros — it means those search terms aren't trending. Instead, pull your actual content performance from Instagram Insights. Post what's worked before, then test a new angle. Zero trends ≠ zero opportunity, just means you need real data from your own account.
creative.source: Google Trends (all zero values indicate insufficient search volume or reporting lag) + absence of your actual Instagram Insights data

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
